[size=3]This mod replaces the farm buildings in a colonial revival-style.[/size]
[size=3]I'm working on replacing all buildings (farm and town) eventually.

[i][color=#999999](Note: The drive I had the files for this saved to died so I lost everything but the .png files (˚ ˃̣̣̥⌓˂̣̣̥ )
I'm going to keep working on this mod when I can, but without the original files I'll probably have to remake it from scratch. I'm just starting uni so I probably won't be able to work on this often.)[/color][/i][/size]

[s][s][color=#666666][s][color=#666666]                                                                                                                               [/color][/s][/color][/s][/s]

[size=3]Farmhouse, Barn, Big Barn, Deluxe Barn, Coop, Big Coop, Deluxe Coop [/size]
[i][color=#999999](Vine version only ATM, due to loss of original files.)[/color][/i]

[size=3]Non-vine version is only the farmhouse.[/size]
